commands: minimal protobuf walk of ModelProto.graph (nodes, initializers, op_types, first/last node, small-tensor values)
onnxruntime run on recognition/tests/fixtures/face_pipeline/synthetic_112_crop.npy under several external scale/channel conventions

input_scale.blocked_reason: Graph input 'data' feeds Conv /conv1/Conv directly. No Sub/Mul/Div/Add scale nodes. File-level float32 encodings of 127.5 and 1/127.5 occur 0 times.

input_offset.blocked_reason: No mean/offset initializer or Sub node is attached to graph input 'data'.

channel_order.blocked_reason: Three input channels and first-conv weights [64,3,3,3] are graph-measured. RGB versus BGR is not encoded (no Transpose / channel-swap node).

alignment.blocked_reason: An ONNX recognizer graph does not encode external five-point alignment. glintr100.onnx has no landmark, affine, warp, or template tensors.

fixture_inference.note: Non-unit L2 on existing fixture pixels confirms the graph does not L2-normalize. These runs do not identify the correct external scale or channel order.

sface_composed_golden.reason: Existing composed SFace golden is not AuraFace proof.

insightface_runtime.reason: insightface is not importable in the lane interpreter, so InsightFace reference preprocessing could not be executed.

local_manifest_assumption.note: FIR512-1/FIRDV-3 S1b assumptions remain UNVERIFIED. This lane did not edit production sources or flip those markers.

evidence_limits: onnx Python package was not installed; graph structure was read with a minimal protobuf walk plus onnxruntime I/O metadata.
Conv node attribute protobuf was not fully decoded; first-conv kernel is taken from initializer dims [64,3,3,3], not from Conv attribute fields.
A single file-level float32 1/255 bit-pattern (count=1) is treated as a coincidental weight value, not a preprocessing node.
Fixture inference used existing synthetic_112_crop.npy pixels only; there is no AuraFace reference embedding for this crop.
Publisher/InsightFace runtime alignment and (x-127.5)/127.5 scaling are external to the ONNX graph and were not executed here.
LICENSE.auraface.md is Apache-2.0 license text and does not document preprocessing.
A blocked independent measurement of input_scale and alignment_template_id is valid evidence; those fields stay unsupported.
unresolved_questions: What external input_scale and offset, if any, this glintr100.onnx expects.
Which five-point 112 template, if any, matches AuraFace training alignment.
Whether the intended channel order is RGB or BGR.
Whether comparison-time L2 should be applied after the graph, given raw outputs are not unit-normalized.
